## The problem

What keeps going wrong, or taking too long, when you work with an AI agent?

## Who it is for

For example: vibe coders, people shipping small tools, anyone running a one-person shop.

## Tools you already use

For example: ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Claude Code, Gmail, X, YouTube.

## A real example

A short account of the last time this happened. What did you try, and what was missing?

## What a good kit would include

Optional. A setup guide, a system prompt, a checklist, an output template, or something else.

## Anything it should not do

Optional. Safety limits, or things a kit like this should refuse.
